tenant.description: One row per client company and the root of isolation: every tenant-scoped row’s tenant_id references it.

legal_entity.description: A registered employer under the tenant, such as an Indian Pvt Ltd, a US Inc, or an EOR partner. Payroll, filings, benefits and thresholds hang off the entity because statutory registrations are per entity.

department.description: Org units as a tree. Carries the cost centre that GL postings roll up to.

location.description: Work locations. state_code drives PT slabs in India and state tax nexus in the US.

app_user.description: Who can log in, distinct from employee (a record about a person). tenant_id is nullable only for Daydor staff, the one deliberate exception to tenant scoping.

role_assignment.description: Grants a role at a scope (tenant, department, team, self). This makes access hierarchical: one person can be an employee everywhere, a manager over a subtree, and the EEO officer by designation.

tenant_compliance_config.description: Soft per-tenant preferences as data, never schema. Holds the switch for whether managers see team pay.

approval_request.description: One polymorphic row per gate instance, pointing at whatever it guards. deadline_at closes Gap 2 (registration_deadline_scheduler) from the design doc.

agent_task_run.description: One row per agent worker execution. Gives gated-irreversible workers a durable idempotency record and lets ops see what agents did without reading Temporal history.

document.description: The vault (document_vault in the 32-table ERD). document_class picks the retention rule; blobs live in India-resident object storage behind signed URLs.

consent_record.description: Purpose- and field-scoped DPDP consent, one row per (employee, data_category, purpose). Only the data principal writes it; PAN, bank and Aadhaar columns cannot be populated without a granted row.

data_subject_request.description: DPDP access, correction and erasure requests with the 90-day clock. partially_fulfilled_retention_held is the honest outcome when a statutory floor wins.

audit_log.description: Append-only business-event log written in the same transaction as the mutation. Indexed by (tenant_id, subject_id, occurred_at) for the 72-hour breach report.

legal_hold.description: Backs the root orchestrator’s legal-hold gate. Every irreversible worker checks for an active hold on its subject before acting.

retention_policy.description: Shared reference: duration plus the anchor field the clock starts from (filed_on, last_entry_date, employee.date_of_exit, created_at). Four statutes, four anchors.

pt_slab_rule.description: Professional-tax slabs per state, effective-dated so a past period always recomputes against the slab in force then.

statutory_rate_rule.description: Generalises the doc’s epf_rate_rule and esi_rate_rule into one effective-dated table keyed by scheme, so US FICA, FUTA and SUI rates fit the same shape.

employee.description: One person in one tenant (employee_core in the 32-table ERD). hire_event_id is the creation idempotency key. Raw Aadhaar is never stored: masked last-4 plus an offline e-KYC reference.

employment_record.description: Effective-dated job and pay structure. Immutable once a payroll run has used it; a raise is a new version. wage_floor_compliant enforces the Labour Codes 50% Basic+DA floor.

position.description: A budgeted seat, distinct from the person in it, so backfills and reorgs keep headcount-plan history. headcount-planner already assumes this exists.

job_profile.description: Company-level reference data the gap analysis flagged as load-bearing: replaces free-text job_title and gives comp-band-validator something to validate against.

comp_band.description: Pay range per job profile and geo, effective-dated. The other half of the job_profile / comp_band follow-up blocking comp-band-validator.

reporting_line.description: Effective-dated reporting edges. A materialised closure built from this table is what the manager RLS policy checks: is this row’s employee anywhere under me?

emergency_contact.description: A flat miss in the 32-table list. Needed from day one at any company size.

work_authorization.description: Case-status tracking for I-9, E-Verify, H-1B, OPT and TN with expiry and next action, instead of a static document in the vault.

self_identification.description: Voluntary EEO self-ID kept apart from decision records in a restricted schema. Hiring managers never see it; reporting reads an aggregate view only.

threshold_obligation.description: Per-scheme applicability (ESI, EPF, Gratuity, POSH, ACA ALE, EEO-1, WARN) per legal entity, with the founder confirmation gate and a registration deadline.

skill.description: One skill catalogue shared by recruiting, performance, learning and succession.

employee_skill.description: Proficiency per person per skill with its source, so training and succession have something to reason from.

job_requisition.description: Request to fill a position, routed for budget sign-off.

job_posting.description: A published req. pay_transparency_checked closes the review flag: no posting goes live without a salary-range check.

candidate.description: A person before hire. Kept separate from employee per TA’s own boundary: candidate is not employee until hire is confirmed.

application.description: Candidate applied to a requisition, with stage history.

screening_result.description: Automated screening output, the highest-exposure decision in TA. Records tool version, audit in force, candidate notice and human review so LL144, IL HB3773 and CO SB24-205 are provable.

aedt_audit.description: Bias-audit currency for each screening tool. aedt-audit-monitor blocks the screener when expires_on has passed.

background_check.description: Vendor check plus the FCRA adverse-action stages. Findings are special category: HR only.

offer.description: Offer drafted from the approved band. within_band false routes to the founder.

checklist.description: One checklist per lifecycle event. kind is onboarding or offboarding, so ER reuses the same shape.

checklist_task.description: Tasks owned by different domains (IT, payroll, the manager, the new hire). blocking tasks hold the next stage.

access_role_template.description: Default app bundle per job profile and department. Anything outside it is an exception gate.

identity_account.description: Directory identity (Google, Okta, Entra). Deprovisioning always passes through a gate.

app_access_grant.description: Per-app access with its source (template or exception). The input to access-compliance-auditor’s drift check.

device_assignment.description: Who holds which device, including the shipping address (restricted).

payroll_profile.description: Per-employee pay setup. Carries the tax-residency fields from the gap analysis (work_state vs tax_state, reciprocity) plus India UAN and ESIC numbers.

payroll_run.description: One cycle for one legal entity. Maker-checker: payroll builds it, the founder releases it.

payslip.description: Derived per employee per run, and pinned to the employment_record version it used so it stays an honest record after later changes.

payslip_line.description: Earnings and deduction components, each pointing at the rule row that produced it, so a recompute is explainable line by line.

garnishment_order.description: Court-ordered deductions. Special category: the issuing authority and order reveal legal circumstances.

filing_record.description: One statutory submission (ECR, ESI, 24Q, 941, W-2, state UI) with its acknowledgement.

gratuity_accrual_balance.description: Running per-employee gratuity liability, read (not recomputed) by final settlement at exit.

contractor_invoice.description: Global and contractor invoices routed through local payment rails.

benefit_plan.description: Plans offered per entity and plan year (group health in India, medical and 401k in the US).

benefit_election.description: What the employee chose, effective-dated, and when it reached the carrier.

dependent.description: Covered family members. Restricted PII about people who are not employees.

life_event.description: Qualifying life events. The event type itself (divorce, birth) is special category.

cobra_event.description: COBRA qualifying events and the statutory notice timeline.

time_punch.description: Raw punches. Geo is restricted and optional.

timecard.description: Approved hours per period, the hand-off from time to payroll.

leave_policy.description: Leave types and accrual rules per entity.

leave_balance.description: Accrued balance per policy, also read by final settlement for encashment.

leave_request.description: Dates are visible to managers; the medical or family reason is special category and hidden from them.

compensation_event.description: A proposed pay change (merit, promotion, adjustment, bonus). Approval writes a new employment_record version rather than editing the old one.

equity_grant.description: Options, RSUs and Indian ESOPs, priced against the valuation in force on the grant date.

option_exercise.description: Exercises with FMV and withholding, an irreversible worker.

valuation_409a.description: US 409A, or the India Rule 11UA FMV report used for ESOP perquisite tax. Stale valuations trip the 409A gate.

review_cycle.description: A review period and its calibration status.

performance_review.description: Self assessment, manager rating, and the calibrated rating that feeds merit.

pip.description: Performance plans are tracked by an agent, never initiated by one.

course.description: Course catalogue with jurisdiction rules (POSH in India, state harassment training in the US).

training_assignment.description: training_record in the 32-table ERD: assigned courses, deadlines and completion.

certification.description: Licences and certifications with expiry; role-critical ones hard-stop.

expense.description: Employee expenses checked against policy and routed by amount.

vendor_bill.description: Three-way match on vendor bills, gated above materiality.

gl_journal_entry.description: Ledger postings. Payroll posts at cost-centre grain, never per employee, so finance staff never infer an individual’s pay from the GL.

er_case.description: Complaints logged and routed by agents, never adjudicated by them. Founder sees that a case exists but not its content, since in a small company the founder may be the subject.

er_case_note.description: Investigation notes, encrypted and append-only. Readable only by the assigned investigator role.

termination.description: The exit event every downstream domain reacts to (IT deprovisioning, final pay, COBRA, equity).

final_settlement.description: Full and final: pending wages, gratuity from the running balance, encashment and recoveries, released through the same disbursal worker as payroll.
